experiment: Grafana GitHub data source query and installation-scope validation

runtime.authentication: GitHub App id, installation id and private key provisioned only in the ephemeral runner

significant_attempts.finding: The existing LAB App was not installed on the personal-account repositories; selected-repository token creation returned repository-not-found.
The existing lab App installation did not grant Actions: read; requesting that permission was rejected.
Plugin version 2.8.1 was not available from the Grafana plugin catalog; the published 2.8.0 build was used for the valid run.
For GitHub.com the plugin configuration must omit githubUrl, and query time-field values are numeric enums in the 2.8.0 backend contract.

significant_attempts.result: dashboard queries worked; table-to-SQL alert did not provide a stable alert path
significant_attempts.finding: The GitHub data source is suitable for current-state tables and drill-down, while critical alerting is simpler through bounded operational metrics.

interpretation.installation_scope_rule: The plugin mints its own installation token. Runtime token repository selection does not downscope plugin queries. A production read-only App must therefore be installed only on the managed fleet.

remaining_acceptance: Create or reuse a dedicated read-only GitHub App installed only on selected personal-account managed repositories.
Grant Actions: read only if workflow-run history is required from the GitHub data source.
Repeat the same query and cross-scope checks on the personal-account installation.
